title: The Sunglasses Scientist
logline: An eight-year-old in sunglasses insists he is a scientist, and his mother believes him.
assumptions: Assumed the card battles happened at the kitchen table.

cast.name: Shaz
cast.look: small round-faced boy, short black hair, dark sunglasses indoors, plain t-shirt

cast.name: Mom
cast.look: kind woman in a soft blue hijab covering all hair and hairline, long modest dress

cast.name: Sister
cast.look: young woman in a grey hijab fully covering hair and hairline, hoodie

locations.name: Kitchen
locations.description: family kitchen with a wooden table
locations.keyLight: soft window light from screen left

beats.narration: I wore sunglasses everywhere. Even inside.

shots.action: Shaz screen-left slaps a card down; sister screen-right
shots.skinTones: Shaz warm medium brown; sister light warm brown

shots.acting: holds back a smile, a slow blink

beats.narration: She never once laughed at me.

directorsNotes: Play the first line completely straight.
